checks.claim: All finite complete orthogonal families including empty families

The reference proves both directions directly. lifted_product_decomposition is bijectivity of the actual Pi.ringHom of quotient maps, and lifted_product_equiv wraps that exact map using RingEquiv.ofBijective. Ideal.span{1-e_j} is the stated principal ideal in a commutative ring.

checks.claim: Naturality for arbitrary compatible system maps
checks.evidence: Morphism fields are exactly the given commuting data. map_limit proves tuple compatibility; lift_natural proves actual coordinate equality by target stage uniqueness; lift_family_natural handles all family components. No injectivity or surjectivity of the base map is assumed.

Truncated polynomial tower has coherent t with every positive power nonzero in a sufficiently deep stage. The dual-number transition (s,m)->(s,xm+s-prime) is a unital ring homomorphism by Leibniz and excludes a coherent lift of x by a coefficient contradiction. The infinite square-zero-variable augmentation ideal is elementwise nil but has nonzero square-free monomials in every ideal power.
